items.title: Boost Insurance approved as Lloyd's coverholder and expands capacity panel
items.summary: Specialty MGA platform Boost Insurance has secured approval as a Lloyd's coverholder alongside an expansion of its global reinsurance panel.

items.title: MS Amlin reports 8% rise in H1 2026 insurance revenue alongside lower profit
items.summary: MS Amlin reported an 8% rise in insurance revenue to £1.051 billion for the six months to September 2026, though adjusted profit fell to £130 million.

items.title: Unicorn Asset Management appoints co-CIOs and new COO
items.summary: Unicorn Asset Management has promoted two long-standing portfolio managers to co-chief investment officers alongside naming a new chief operating officer.

items.title: FOS and FCA publish joint report showing insurers lose half of claims delay disputes
items.summary: A new recurring thematic report from UK regulators reveals that insurers lost half of all claims delay disputes investigated by the Financial Ombudsman Service over a five-year period.

items.title: Quilter Cheviot research highlights mixed trust sector progress
items.summary: Research from Quilter Cheviot indicates marginal improvements in corporate governance within the investment trust sector alongside a deterioration in responsible investment disclosures.

items.title: Professional Pensions announces winners of the 2026 Investment Awards
items.summary: Professional Pensions has revealed the winners of its 13th annual investment awards, celebrating asset managers serving UK occupational pension schemes.
